subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed `SKILL.md` diagnostics be accepted as a dedicated `openclaw skills lint` surface first, or must the same failures also appear in normal `skills list`, `skills check`, gateway status, and Web status before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: Current main has no user-visible failure object for malformed skill candidates, while the open PR implements a narrower lint-first path; only maintainers can choose the supported product surface and redaction boundary.

options.title: Require status/list/Web parity for closure
options.body: Treat lint as useful but keep this issue open until normal skill status surfaces can also report skipped malformed candidates.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Land the lint command as the first supported diagnostic surface and track broader status/Web visibility separately.

options.title: Pause for a different design
options.body: Pause the open PR if maintainers want diagnostics handled through existing doctor/status commands instead of a new lint command.

recommendation.title: Require status/list/Web parity for closure
recommendation.body: Treat lint as useful but keep this issue open until normal skill status surfaces can also report skipped malformed candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the most direct current ownership across the skill loader, status, and CLI paths that would need the scope decision.
